name: Broadcast Notification
description: ارسال اعلان همگانی (Broadcast) به تمام کاربران فعال سامانه

request_body.message: Scheduled maintenance tonight at 02:00 AM UTC.
request_body.title: System Maintenance

body.message: broadcast notification dispatched to all active users

how_to_run.curl:
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/notifications/broadcast" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ADMIN_JWT_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"System Maintenance","message":"Scheduled maintenance tonight at 02:00 AM UTC."}'
